Selecting continuous counting will automatically make the PLL divider output visible at vtp24 TDO GPIO and switch vtp23 to input if OUTENP bit is set to high and chip is operating in test mode or ATM. This is achieved by indicating the continuous clocking mode and the active protection bit value from SCU to TCU via plldiv out en req signal . Here the corresponding test functionality of vtp24 TDO GPIO and vtp23 will be directly enabled in this case.
